data.rationale: The proposal gets the procedure and all seven parameters right (use_points corresponds to payment_type) and includes the 'Continue to flight results' interstitial, but it puts the points selection before the search, when the real flow switches to Points inside Sort & Filter on the results page. Its step for that choice is also vague ('tick Use TrueBlue points or switch to Points').
